propositions: Bare `import alert_dedup` in scripts/canary_bridge.py and scripts/dependency_audit.py fails with ModuleNotFoundError when test files are run as subsets outside the full pytest session
CI passes because tests/scripts/conftest.py inserts scripts/ on sys.path at collection time, causing the side effect to leak into later-collected test modules in the same session

Both sites require explicit sys.path.insert of their own directory derived from __file__ immediately above the bare import to be invocation-independent across direct script execution, pytest subset runs, and importlib.util.spec_from_file_location

A new guard test tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py must be added to detect any future bare sibling imports under scripts/ that lack the required sys.path insert, paired with a subprocess check that verifies the affected test module collects when run alone
